attributes.action: Amend the Online Safety Act to allow sexual acts performed by consenting adults
attributes.additional_details: Simply, pornography is not going away, and it is not the acts within it that is the issue, The real problem is the depiction of consent. Making it illegal to sit on someone's face won't make women and girls safer, but proper education about consent will. Content that shows people crying being beaten unconsensually for purpose of narrative is still allowed, which will have more influence on how someone thinks they can treat another. Work with the pornography industry to promote safe practices.
attributes.background:
Amendments to the Online Safety Act 2023 have criminalised digital recording of sexual acts that are legal to perform off camera between consenting adults, these changes have affected the the livelihoods of many within the sex work industry
Education about porn in general is the solution, not bans

rejection.details:
